snippet.title: Head On - (1979) - Arcade - gameplay
snippet.description:
Head-On
Gremlin Industries © 1979 
[Coin-Op] Arcade Video Game 
Emulator: Mame 1.91

The original from Sega/Gremlin.  Here's how it's done.  The right mix of playability, learning, planning ahead and getting to know the computer AI. The speed is just right, and even at the higher levels with 2 cars (or more), it's still playable.  I was even to get to Level 4.  That's a great game!

You may have not seen this before, but I think its a classic.  Try to collect the dots, (yes this comes BEFORE pac-man) while avoiding the other car.  You can switch lanes only at an intersection, so you'll want to get there first and not be stuck in a lane when the enemy closes you in.  I didn't know at higher levels the enemy cars can change two lanes just like you so watch out!  After multiple attempts and learning, I finally got to level 4 and scored 7200 pts! 

There are other bootlegs/clones like the IREM one, and the Sidam one, but I just like the original the best for sounds and everything.
